name: Strongfoot
body:
You can no longer be tripped.

Prerequisite: Zif

Benefit: You are immune to the trip maneuver. You can stand up from the prone position as a swift action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
